description: Moves things into a folder, or out of every folder with `folderId: null`. Anything from any tool can go in: pass each one's `kind` and `id` as search_workspace or workspace_folders_browse gave them. A thing lives in one folder, so filing it somewhere moves it. Things the person can't see are skipped. May return needs_confirmation.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior needs_confirmation envelope.

folderId.description: Where they go; null takes them out of their folders.

items.description: The things to move: kind and id from search_workspace or workspace_folders_browse.

workspace.description: Workspace slug, for tokens without a default.

name: workspace_folders_file
title: Move things into a folder
